doc: docs/06 §3 dose schedule: control-vector scales per stage (P2.04). `malice` is the tweet-malice vector scale and must equal the `dose` column of docs/02 §9 in game/data/sampling.json (SteeringTest enforces the match); `path` is this stage's path-vector weight, and the locked path picks the file (P3.03/P2.03). The [0, 12] clamp and the calmer-mode stage-3 cap are code rules in Steering.gd (docs/06 §5, docs/02 §8) and are deliberately not tunable here. Retune by blind-reading transcripts (docs/06 §3).
